name: Testimonial
description: Semantic written testimonial with quote, person, role, company, avatar and logo slots.
designIntent: Review and landing pages repeat the same quote hierarchy. Testimonial uses figure, blockquote and figcaption so the attribution is real structure instead of three styled paragraphs.

props.name: logo
props.description: Brand or logo slot shown in the card header.

examples.title: Written testimonial
examples.code:
<Testimonial
  quote="The right advisor changed the outcome."
  name="Bob Falahee"
  role="CEO"
  company="Blind & Shade"
  avatar={<Avatar><AvatarFallback>BF</AvatarFallback></Avatar>}
/>

antiPatterns.title: Don't add quotation marks in the quote prop
antiPatterns.explanation: The component renders the quotation marks. Duplicating them produces doubled punctuation.

accessibility.userRequirements: Keep the person name in the figcaption
Use an avatar with a fallback and avoid a redundant alt text

compositionRules.relationship: Place several testimonials in a Grid for a quote wall
